description: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.

en.question: What has appeared on the belt?
